ayahs.3: Allah Taala jo zabardast hai aur hikmat wala hai isi tarah teri taraf aur tujh se aglon ki taraf wahi bhejta raha.
ayahs.4: Aasmanon ki (tamaam) cheezen aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai sab usi ka hai, woh bartar aur azeem-ush-shaan hai.
ayahs.5: Qareeb hai aasman oopar se phat paden aur tamaam farishte apne Rabb ki paaki tareef ke saath bayan kar rahe hain aur zameen walon ke liye istighfar kar rahe hain. Khoob samajh rakho ke Allah Taala hi maaf farmaane wala, rehmat wala hai.
ayahs.6: Aur jin logon ne us ke siwa doosron ko karsaz bana liya hai Allah Taala un par nigraan hai aur aap un ke zimma-daar nahin hain.
ayahs.7: Isi tarah hum ne aap ki taraf Arabi Quran ki wahi ki hai taake aap Makka walon ko aur us ke aas paas ke logon ko khabardaar kar den aur jama hone ke din se jis ke aane mein koi shak nahin dara den. Ek giroh jannat mein hoga aur ek giroh jahannam mein hoga.
ayahs.8: Agar Allah Taala chahta to un sab ko ek hi ummat ka bana deta lekin woh jise chahta hai apni rehmat mein daakhil kar leta hai aur zaalimon ka haami aur madadgaar koi nahin.
ayahs.9: Kya in logon ne Allah Taala ke siwa aur karsaz bana liye hain, (haqeeqatan to) Allah Taala hi karsaz hai, wohi murdon ko zinda karega aur wohi har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.10: Aur jis jis cheez mein tumhara ikhtilaaf ho us ka faisla Allah Taala hi ki taraf hai. Yehi Allah mera Rabb hai jis par main ne bharosa kar rakha hai aur jis ki taraf main jhukta hoon.
ayahs.11: Woh aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karne wala hai, us ne tumhare liye tumhari jins ke jode bana diye hain aur chaupaayon ke jode banaaye hain, tumhein woh is mein phaila raha hai, us jaisi koi cheez nahin, woh sunne aur dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.12: Aasmanon aur zameen ki kunjiyan usi ki hain, jis ki chaahe rozi kushada karde aur tang karde, yaqeenan woh har cheez ko jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.13: Allah Taala ne tumhare liye wohi deen muqarrar kar diya hai jis ke qaim karne ka us ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko hukm diya tha aur jo (ba-zariya-e-wahi) hum ne teri taraf bhej di hai, aur jis ka taakeedi hukm hum ne Ibraheem aur Moosa aur Eesa (alaihimus salaam) ko diya tha, ke is deen ko qaim rakhna aur is mein phoot na daalna, jis cheez ki taraf aap unhein bula rahe hain woh to (un) mushrikeen par giraan guzarti hai, Allah Taala jise chahta hai apna barguzeeda banaata hai aur jo bhi us ki taraf ruju kare woh us ki saheeh rahnumai karta hai.
ayahs.14: In logon ne apne paas ilm aa jaane ke baad hi ikhtilaaf kiya (aur woh bhi) baahmi zidd-bahas se, aur agar aap ke Rabb ki baat ek waqt-e-muqarrar tak ke liye pehle hi se qaraar paa gayi hui na hoti to yaqeenan un ka faisla ho chuka hota, aur jin logon ko un ke baad kitaab di gayi hai woh bhi us ki taraf se uljhan wale shak mein pade hue hain.
ayahs.15: Pas aap logon ko isi taraf bulaate rahen aur jo kuchh aap se kaha gaya hai us par mazbooti se jam jaayen aur un ki khwahishon par na chalen aur keh den ke Allah Taala ne jitni kitaaben naazil farmaayi hain mera un par imaan hai aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke tum mein insaaf karta rahoon. Hamara aur tum sab ka Parwardigaar Allah hi hai, hamare aamaal hamare liye hain aur tumhare aamaal tumhare liye hain, hum tum mein koi kat-hujjati nahin, Allah Taala hum (sab) ko jama karega aur isi ki taraf lautna hai.
ayahs.16: Aur jo log Allah Taala ki baaton mein jhagda daalte hain us ke baad ke (makhlooq) ise maan chuki, un ki kat-hujjati Allah ke nazdeek baatil hai, aur un par ghazab hai aur un ke liye sakht azaab hai.
ayahs.17: Allah Taala ne haq ke saath kitaab naazil farmaayi hai aur taraazu bhi (utaari hai) aur aap ko kya khabar shayad qayamat qareeb hi ho.
ayahs.18: Us ki jaldi unhein padi hai jo ise nahin maante aur jo us par yaqeen rakhte hain woh to us se dar rahe hain, unhein us ke haq hone ka poora ilm hai. Yaad rakho jo log qayamat ke maamle mein lad-jhagad rahe hain, woh door ki gumraahi mein pade hue hain.
ayahs.19: Allah Taala apne bandon par bada hi lutf karne wala hai, jise chahta hai kushada rozi deta hai aur woh badi taaqat, bade ghalbe wala hai.
ayahs.20: Jis ka irada aakhirat ki kheti ka ho hum use us ki kheti mein taraqqi denge aur jo dunya ki kheti ki talab rakhta ho hum use us mein se hi kuchh de denge, aise shakhs ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin.
ayahs.21: Kya in logon ne aise (Allah ke) shareek (muqarrar kar rakhe) hain jinhon ne aise ahkaam-e-deen muqarrar kar diye hain jo Allah ke farmaaye hue nahin hain. Agar faisle ke din ka waada na hota to (abhi hi) un mein faisla kar diya jaata. Yaqeenan (un) zaalimon ke liye hi dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.22: Aap dekhenge ke yeh zaalim apne aamaal se dar rahe honge jin ke wabaal un par waaqe hone wale hain, aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye woh bahishton ke baaghaat mein honge, woh jo khwahish karen apne Rabb ke paas maujood paayenge, yehi hai bada fazl.
ayahs.23: Yehi woh hai jis ki basharat Allah Taala apne un bandon ko de raha hai jo imaan laaye aur (sunnat ke mutaabiq) nek amal kiye, to keh dijiye! Ke main is par tum se koi badla nahin chahta magar mohabbat-e-rishtadaari ki. Jo shakhs koi neki kare hum us ke liye us ki neki mein aur neki badha denge. Beshak Allah Taala bakhshne wala (aur) bahut qadr-daan hai.
ayahs.24: Kya yeh kehte hain ke (Paighambar ne) Allah par jhoot baandha hai, agar Allah Taala chaahe to aap ke dil par mohar laga de aur Allah Taala apni baaton se jhoot ko mita deta hai aur sach ko saabit rakhta hai. Woh seenon ki baaton ko jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.25: Wohi hai jo apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmaata hai aur gunaahon se darguzar farmaata hai aur jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho (sab) jaanta hai.
ayahs.26: Imaan walon aur nekokaar logon ki sunta hai aur unhein apne fazl se aur badha kar deta hai aur kuffar ke liye sakht azaab hai.
ayahs.27: Agar Allah Taala apne (sab) bandon ki rozi faraakh kar deta to woh zameen mein fasaad barpa kar dete lekin woh andaaze ke saath jo kuchh chahta hai naazil farmaata hai. Woh apne bandon se poora khabardaar hai aur khoob dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.28: Aur wohi hai jo logon ke na-ummeed ho jaane ke baad baarish barsaata aur apni rehmat phaila deta hai, wohi hai karsaz aur qaabil-e-hamd-o-sana.
ayahs.29: Aur us ki nishaniyon mein se aasmanon aur zameen ki paidaaish hai aur un mein jaandaaron ka phailaana hai. Woh is par bhi qaadir hai ke jab chaahe unhein jama karde.
ayahs.30: Tumhein jo kuchh museebaten pahunchti hain woh tumhare apne haathon ke kartoot ka badla hai, aur woh to bahut si baaton se darguzar farma deta hai.
ayahs.31: Aur tum hamein zameen mein aajiz karne wale nahin ho, tumhare liye siwaaye Allah Taala ke na koi karsaz hai na madadgaar.
ayahs.32: Aur darya mein chalne wali pahaadon jaisi kashtiyan us ki nishaniyon mein se hain.
ayahs.33: Agar woh chaahe to hawa band karde aur yeh kashtiyan samandaron par ruki reh jaayen. Yaqeenan is mein har sabr karne wale shukr-guzar ke liye nishaniyan hain.
ayahs.34: Ya unhein un ke kartooton ke baais tabaah karde, woh to bahut si khataon se darguzar farmaaya karta hai.
ayahs.35: Aur taake jo log hamari nishaniyon mein jhagdate hain woh maloom kar len ke un ke liye koi chhutkaara nahin.
ayahs.36: To tumhein jo kuchh diya gaya hai woh zindagaani-e-dunya ka kuchh yunhi sa asbaab hai, aur Allah ke paas jo hai woh us se ba-darja behtar aur paayedaar hai, woh un ke liye hai jo imaan laaye aur sirf apne Rabb hi par bharosa rakhte hain.
ayahs.37: Aur kabeera gunaahon se aur be-hayaaiyon se bachte hain aur ghusse ke waqt (bhi) maaf kar dete hain.
ayahs.38: Aur apne Rabb ke farmaan ko qabool karte hain aur namaz ki pabandi karte hain aur un ka (har) kaam aapas ke mashware se hota hai, aur jo hum ne unhein de rakha hai us mein se (hamare naam par) dete hain.
ayahs.39: Aur jab un par zulm (o-ziyaadati) ho to woh sirf badla le lete hain.
ayahs.40: Aur buraai ka badla isi jaisi buraai hai, aur jo maaf kar de aur islaah kar le us ka ajr Allah ke zimme hai, (fil-waaqea) Allah Taala zaalimon se mohabbat nahin karta.
ayahs.41: Aur jo shakhs apne mazloom hone ke baad (baraabar ka) badla le le to aise logon par (ilzaam ka) koi raasta nahin.
ayahs.42: Yeh raasta sirf un logon par hai jo khud doosron par zulm karen aur zameen mein na-haq fasaad karte phiren, yehi log hain jin ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.43: Aur jo shakhs sabr kar le aur maaf karde yaqeenan yeh badi himmat ke kaamon mein se (ek kaam) hai.
ayahs.44: Aur jise Allah Taala behka de us ka us ke baad koi chaara-saaz nahin, aur tu dekhega ke zaalim log azaab ko dekh kar keh rahe honge ke kya waapas jaane ki koi raah hai.
ayahs.45: Aur tu unhein dekhega ke woh (jahannam ke) saamne laa khade kiye jaayenge, maare zillat ke jhuke ja rahe honge aur kankhiyon se dekh rahe honge, imaan wale saaf kahenge ke haqeeqi ziyankaar woh hain jinhon ne aaj qayamat ke din apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko nuqsaan mein daal diya. Yaad rakho ke yaqeenan zaalim log dawami azaab mein hain.
ayahs.46: Un ke koi madadgaar nahin jo Allah Taala se alag un ki imdaad kar saken aur jise Allah gumraah karde us ke liye koi raasta hi nahin.
ayahs.47: Apne Rabb ka hukm maan lo us se pehle ke Allah ki jaanib se woh din aa jaaye jis ka hat jaana na-mumkin hai, tumhein us roz na to koi panaah ki jagah milegi na chhup kar anjaan ban jaane ki.
ayahs.48: Agar yeh munh pher len to hum ne aap ko un par nigehbaan bana kar nahin bheja, aap ke zimme to sirf paighaam pahuncha dena hai, hum jab kabhi insaan ko apni mehrbaani ka maza chakhate hain to woh us par itra jaata hai aur agar unhein un ke aamaal ki wajah se koi museebat pahunchti hai to beshak insaan bada hi naa-shukra hai.
ayahs.49: Aasmanon ki aur zameen ki saltanat Allah Taala hi ke liye hai, woh jo chahta hai paida karta hai, jis ko chahta hai betiyan deta hai aur jise chahta hai bete deta hai.
ayahs.50: Ya unhein jama kar deta hai bete bhi aur betiyan bhi aur jise chaahe baanjh kar deta hai, woh bade ilm wala aur kaamil qudrat wala hai.
ayahs.51: Na-mumkin hai ke kisi bande se Allah Taala kalaam kare magar wahi ke zariye ya parde ke peechhe se ya kisi farishte ko bheje aur woh Allah ke hukm se jo woh chaahe wahi kare, beshak woh bartar hai, hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.52: Aur isi tarah hum ne aap ki taraf apne hukm se rooh ko utaara hai, aap is se pehle yeh bhi nahin jaante the ke kitaab aur imaan kya cheez hai? Lekin hum ne ise noor banaaya, is ke zariye se apne bandon mein se jise chaahte hain, hidayat dete hain, beshak aap raah-e-raast ki rahnumaai kar rahe hain.
ayahs.53: Us Allah ki raah ki jis ki milkiyat mein aasmanon aur zameen ki har cheez hai. Aagaah raho sab kaam Allah Taala hi ki taraf lautte hain.
